_what: LIVEHD_SIM_SPLIT_DEBUG's trace must reach a stream a caller can read. It went to stdout, which lhd owns for its structured result, so the documented way to diagnose a surviving cycle printed nothing through the driver.

mutants.name: S1 peel trace back to stdout
mutants.old: std::print(stderr, "split[dbg]: peel seeds={} of {}\n", q.size(), indeg.size());
mutants.new: std::print("split[dbg]: peel seeds={} of {}\n", q.size(), indeg.size());

mutants.name: S2 on-cycle count back to stdout
mutants.old: std::print(stderr, "split[dbg]: {} comb node(s), {} on a word-level cycle\n", comb_nodes.size(), in_cycle.size());
mutants.new: std::print("split[dbg]: {} comb node(s), {} on a word-level cycle\n", comb_nodes.size(), in_cycle.size());
